name_reason: Renamed ch26_pickup -> ch26_wode_recruit (category item_pickup -> char_recruit). '3d' is dispatch index 0x3D (table entry @ 0x51C85). The '_pickup' descriptor was INVERTED: the handler CONSUMES key item 0xD0 (control hub / 控制中樞, via fd2_remove_inventory_slot_at) and PERMANENTLY recruits char 0x1F (渥德/wode, 機甲兵) via fd2_init_runtime_char_from_base_growth (menu-party roster + member_count++) -- it does not pick anything up. It also collided with the genuine ch26 item-pickup handler 0x3A. Same permanent-recruit mechanism as handler_32 (莎拉/Sara). chapter_26.md already narrates this as '渥德招募' (Wode recruitment).
purpose: Chapter-26 major-quest tile-step event handler (dispatch idx 0x3D): first time only, if the stepping char carries key item 0xD0 (control hub) consume it, play a 59-frame FDOTHER.DAT[0x2D] cinematic, and spawn joining char 0x1F (robot 渥德); otherwise show a 'you don't have it' dialog without consuming the tile.
logic_summary: Gate on tile_event_consumed_flags[0xC]==0 (first time only; else return immediately). Load the stepping char's portrait (runtime_char_array[char].portrait_id, stride 0x50, field +7). Search that char's inventory for item 0xD0 via fd2_find_inventory_slot_with_item. If slot == -1 (not carrying it): show dialog page 2 to render target 0xA951F, paint portrait, wait for input, slide status screen out, and return WITHOUT marking the tile consumed (retryable). If carrying it: remove that inventory slot (consume item 0xD0), show dialog page 3 (target 0xA951F), wait, slide out; load FDOTHER.DAT sprite atlas idx 0x2D via fd2_load_dat_resource, blit frames [0,0x3B)=59 to VGA target 0xABCE4 (pitch 0x140) with 2 BIOS ticks per frame, free the atlas; mark flags[0xC]=1 (consume tile), tick tile-event animations, reload chapter portraits (set 1), spawn char 0x1F from base+growth, and show full-screen dialog page 4 (target 0xA0000).

params.name: stepping_char_id
params.semantics: Tile-step ABI argument: the runtime-char index of the unit that stepped on the tile (read from [ESP+0xc] after the two register pushes = first cdecl stack arg). Used as the char whose portrait is loaded, whose inventory is searched for item 0xD0, and from whom the matching inventory slot is removed.
params.reason: Name accurately reflects the value and its three uses in the body; matches sibling tile-step handlers in this file (handler_3a/3b/3c) using the same ABI param name. No address residue, not a param_N placeholder.

returns.semantics: No return value. Effects are entirely via global state / display: dialog pages, inventory removal, tile-event consume flag, char spawn, and the on-screen cinematic.

reads_globals: data_fd2_field_map_tile_event_consumed_flags_ptr (offset +0xC: the ch26-quest tile consume flag; read in the first-time gate)
writes_globals: data_fd2_field_map_tile_event_consumed_flags_ptr (offset +0xC set to 1 in the carrying-item branch to consume the tile)
ghidra_plate_action: rewrote plate: category 'major-quest item pickup' -> char_recruit; clarified it consumes item 0xD0 and recruits char 0x1F (渥德), _pickup name was inverted.
